objective: Cheap externally available condition evidence improves first-screen confirmed yield beyond frozen prior mixing, under the same menu, budget and release rules.
fallback_on_missing_features: frozen static prior; never delete difficult or missing candidates after seeing outcomes
forbidden_inputs: target outcomes used in shared fitting without explicit restriction

acquisition_priority.source: Existing Jaaks/GDSC dose design and public single-agent response records
features: dose relative to supported potency range
curve slope and efficacy if recorded
acquisition_priority.rule: Use original assay and units. Old IC50 pretraining is not a new experiment; require richer dose support or changed endpoint observation model. Current target-culture readings are not free external inputs.

acquisition_priority.source: ChEMBL mechanism and activity API, existing drug-target annotations
acquisition_priority.rule: Resolve molecule identity before activity lookup; do not merge Ki/Kd/IC50/EC50 as equivalent or infer cellular occupancy from biochemical potency. Compound mixtures remain mixtures.

Metadata coverage first, selective download second. Separate exact context from transported context. Perturbed public cell state is reference evidence, not proof of target culture state or compensation mechanism.

models: small ridge residual ranker with tier A
split: Outer complete cell groups; all roles and repeats of a cell stay together. Inner groups select shrinkage; target labels remain in evaluator. Seen pair/new cell and held-out pair are separate claims.
primary_metric: paired confirmation difference at fixed credits and deadline; retain original source positive definition
continuation_gate: Define economically meaningful delta before evaluating newly reserved data. Require gain over the appropriate strong static baseline and information-destroying control; report dependent uncertainty. Existing 14 exposed cells remain development only.
